entries.7c06a86cd2596e8a: For the construction and plant industries, this business dispatches engineers such as construction management engineers and CAD operators, and also undertakes construction drawing preparation contracts. It covers building, civil engineering, air-conditioning and sanitation, and electrical equipment, and has business bases in Tokyo as well as Hokkaido, Tohoku, Chubu, Kansai and Kyushu. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥21,283 million.
